title: Revealio Scenario
description: Data-first source of truth for a Revealio serious game scenario. Every field here maps to runtime behavior in app/lib/runtime.ts or a module in app/scenarios/[scenarioId]/play/handlers/modules/. Extending this schema is the way to add new declarative capabilities — DO NOT add scenario-specific logic to TypeScript modules.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this JSON schema for IDE autocomplete.

scenario_id.description: Unique scenario identifier — MUST match the folder name (snake_case).

version.description: Semantic version of the scenario content (e.g. '1.0.0'). Bump on gameplay-affecting changes.

locale.description: Content locale — drives prompts, UI copy, TTS voice defaults.

meta.description: Discoverability + presentation metadata (used by the home page grid and the scenario intro screen).

difficulty.description: Displayed as a colored badge on the home. Legacy scenarios utilisent parfois du free-form FR ('avancé', 'intermédiaire', 'pour débuter'). Nouveaux scenarios: privilégier 'junior' | 'intermediate' | 'senior'.

estimated_duration_min.description: Displayed to the player before starting.

job_family.description: Category (e.g. 'founder', 'sales', 'management') — drives home filtering and founder-mode lock.

show_objective.description: If false, hide the 'Objectif' block in the LeftSidebar (per scenario).

show_background_fact.description: If false, hide the 'Info vérifiée' block in the BriefingOverlay.

introduction.description: Screens shown to the player before the game starts (context + tutorial cards).

narrative.description: Story anchors displayed in the briefing + right panel. All fields optional; used verbatim.

one_pager.description: S1-style one-pager overlay config (see components/OnePagerEditor.tsx). If absent, hardcoded 'Orisio' fallback kicks in.

timeline.description: Time-of-day metadata used for the simulated clock in the header.

actors.description: All characters the player can interact with (player + NPCs).

actor_id.description: Unique id used in ai_actors, entry_events, mail from/to.

controlled_by.description: 'ai' actors require a prompt_file. 'player' is the human. 'system' is used for narrator/env messages.

prompt_file.description: Path to the roleplay prompt (relative to scenario folder, e.g. 'prompts/sofia.md'). Required for controlled_by='ai'. Legacy scenarios utilisent parfois un objet {file, ...} — string préféré.

tts_voice.description: OpenAI TTS voice id. Nouveaux scenarios: string parmi alloy/echo/fable/onyx/nova/shimmer/coral. Legacy toléré sur type libre.

mail_only.description: If true, this actor cannot be talked to via chat — only via mail.

busy_after_phase.description: Actor becomes visually unavailable in contacts once this phase_id has completed.

channels.description: Communication channels available (chat, mail, voice, etc.) — currently informational, actual availability is per-phase.

resources.description: Attached documents + data-first templates (see clinicalContractTemplates for S3).

clinical_contract_templates.description: S3-specific: 3 variantes CHU/SM/Clinique. Consommé par lib/clinicalContractTemplates.ts avec fallback constantes TypeScript.

constraints.description: Free-form scenario constraints (e.g. budget, time pressure).

initial_events.description: Events injected once at scenario start (before phase 0).

default_ending.description: Fallback ending. Legacy scenarios utilisent un objet inline {ending_id, label, content}; nouveaux scenarios peuvent utiliser un string qui référence endings[].ending_id.

competencies_evaluated.description: Liste des compétences évaluées à la fin du scenario. Accepte string (legacy) ou objet {competency, description}.

contact_visibility_mode.description: 'auto' shows every actor in the contacts panel; 'explicit' shows only those listed in phase.chat_visible_actors.

phase_focus.description: System-prompt fragment prepended to actor prompts in this phase. Steers the AI's role for the current step.

interaction_mode.description: LEGACY: single-mode declaration. Prefer 'interaction_modes' (array). If both are set, 'interaction_modes' wins. Kept for backward compatibility — the loader normalizes single → [single, 'text'] when interaction_modes is absent.

interaction_modes.description: Ordered list of interaction modes the phase supports, best-preferred first. The moteur probes browser capability at boot (voiceCapability.ts) and picks the first supported mode via pickBestMode(). 'text' is always a valid fallback and is auto-appended if absent, so no phase becomes unplayable when the mic is unavailable. Verrouillé par le garde-fou __tests__/interactionModes.coverage.test.ts.

timer_multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to max_duration_sec when this mode is picked. Typing takes longer than speaking — use 3 for text fallback of a voice phase. 0 = disable timer for this mode (equivalent to disable_timer:true).

disable_timer.description: Force-disables the max_duration_sec cap when this mode is picked. Takes precedence over timer_multiplier.

mode_config.description: Per-mode overrides. Keys are mode names from interaction_modes (e.g. 'voice', 'text'). Currently supports timer_multiplier and disable_timer. Example: { "text": { "timer_multiplier": 3 } } triples the phase deadline when the moteur falls back from voice → text.

ai_actors.description: Actor ids active in this phase. May include placeholders 'chosen_cto' / 'chosen_kol' resolved at runtime by dynamicActorResolution.ts.

chat_visible_actors.description: Only used when scenario.contact_visibility_mode === 'explicit'. Whitelist of actors shown in the contacts panel in this phase.

dynamic_actor.description: Marker consumed by handlers/dynamicActorResolution.ts. Flips to 'resolved' after substitution to make the resolution idempotent.

dynamic_mail_to.description: S3/S4 marker: mail_config.defaults.to will be replaced by the establishment email chosen by the player.

modules.description: Enables the corresponding PhaseModule. If a module is listed here, its lifecycle hooks (enter_phase, mail_sent, contract_signed, etc.) are invoked before the legacy fallback in page.tsx. This enum is verrouillé par un test — voir app/scenarios/[scenarioId]/play/handlers/PhaseModuleRegistry.ts. Les types 'chat', 'timer', 'debrief' sont whitelistés (KNOWN_UNIMPLEMENTED_MODULE_TYPES) : autorisés dans les scenarios mais résolus au niveau du runtime (chat) / d'un hook (timer) / TODO (debrief).

max_duration_sec.description: Hard cap: phase auto-completes when reached. Fires via usePhaseTimer + phaseMaxDurationTriggeredRef.

auto_advance.description: If true, the phase advances as soon as its completion_rules pass (no user click). Used sparingly.

min_player_messages.description: Fallback advance rule when no completion_rules: phase completes after N player messages (default 2).

failure_rules.description: Loop-back mechanic: if NPC response contains these keywords, player is sent back to a previous phase. See runtime.handlePhaseFailure.

next_phase.description: Optional explicit successor. Defaults to next phase in the array. Nouveau: string phase_id ou 'finish'. Legacy: parfois un objet {phase_id, ...}.

items.description: Un critère de scoring évalué par l'IA. Le field d'identité est `criterion_id` (legacy) — TOUTE ligne du code qui lit ce tableau doit accepter les 2 formes. Nouveaux scenarios: utiliser `criterion_id` pour rester cohérent.

mail_config.description: Enables the mail compose form in this phase. Consumed by MailModule (or the legacy fallback in useSendMail). `enabled` défaut à true si absent.

kind.description: Free-form kind key used by MailModule.handle to branch.

send_advances_phase.description: If true, sending the mail triggers checkCompletionRules → advance. Combine with on_send_flags + any_flags in completion_rules for the classic 'submit form to advance' pattern.

on_send_flags.description: Flags set on session.flags at the moment the mail is sent. Typically the same flag that appears in completion_rules.any_flags.

children_names.description: CMJ mode: names for the raised-hand children UI.

advancement.description: S5 phase-1 prospection: declarative advancement config consumed by MailModule.handleDsiResponseReply.

chat_context_enrichment.description: Per-actor list of context keys to inject into the chat prompt (see lib/chatContextEnrichment).

completionRules.description: ⚠ SYNC WITH types.ts:CompletionRules AND runtime.isCurrentPhaseValidatedByRules. Adding a key here without extending BOTH will fail the coverage test (lib/__tests__/checkCompletionRules.coverage.test.ts).

min_score.description: Phase completes if phase score >= this value.

any_flags.description: Phase completes if ANY of these flags is truthy on session.flags.

all_flags.description: Phase completes if ALL of these flags are truthy.

max_exchanges.description: Phase completes after N total player+NPC messages, IF required_*_evidence also pass.

custom.description: Reserved: expression evaluated against session state. NOT YET IMPLEMENTED in runtime.

required_criteria.description: E-chantier: ids of criteria (declared in phase.evaluation.observed_criteria) that MUST all be observed=true for the phase to complete. The moteur cross-checks the AI-produced observation against this list. Failure = specific missing_criteria surfaced in EvaluationResult, no AI 'phase_passed' guessing.

critical_failure_criteria.description: W-chantier — ids de critères qui, s'ils SONT observés (observed=true) ET marqués severity='critical', déclenchent un échec IMMÉDIAT de la phase, court-circuitant toute autre règle. Utilisé pour les erreurs rédhibitoires (divulgation secret, insulte client, mensonge documenté). Chaque id ici doit être déclaré dans evaluation.observed_criteria avec severity='critical' (garde-fou W5 vérifie cette cohérence).

min_criteria_count.description: E-chantier: number of criteria (from phase.evaluation.observed_criteria) that must be observed=true. Use as an alternative to required_criteria when partial credit is acceptable. Combined with required_criteria if both present (required first, then min count of any others).

phaseEvaluation.description: E-chantier — Declarative evaluation contract (F1 of the E-chantier). The AI ONLY reports which of these criteria it observed; the moteur applies completion_rules.required_criteria / min_criteria_count to decide pass/fail. No more 'phase_passed' guessing. Every completion_rules.required_criteria id MUST appear in observed_criteria (checked by garde-fou E6).

observed_criteria.description: List of criteria the AI observes on the player's behavior. Each criterion has a stable id (used by completion_rules) and a short natural-language description that goes into the AI's evaluation prompt.

id.description: Stable snake_case identifier — referenced by completion_rules.required_criteria and persisted in session.evaluation_history.

description.description: Human-readable, injected into the AI evaluation prompt (e.g. 'Le joueur a identifié le besoin explicite du client').

expected.description: Optional: the value the moteur EXPECTS for the phase to pass. Defaults to true. Setting to false lets you assert 'the player did NOT insult the client' as a criterion.

weight.description: Optional: relative importance used by min_criteria_count (weighted sum). Defaults to 1.

severity.description:
W-chantier — pedagogical severity of the criterion:
- 'critical'  : missing this = immediate phase failure, no other rule evaluated (ex: 'a divulgué un secret industriel'). Referenced by completion_rules.critical_failure_criteria.
- 'required'  : must be observed to pass (ex: 'a identifié le besoin client'). Referenced by completion_rules.required_criteria.
- 'bonus'     : observing it adds to the score but is not mandatory (ex: 'a proposé une deadline précise').
- 'minor'     : low-weight contribution to min_criteria_count (ex: 'a dit bonjour').
Defaults to 'required' when omitted (preserves legacy behavior). Verrouillé par le garde-fou W5.

competencies.description: CF-chantier — ids de compétences du référentiel data/competencies.json auxquelles ce critère contribue. Un critère peut pointer vers plusieurs compétences. Permet l'agrégation transverse ('taux de matching en Communication'). Vérifié par le garde-fou EVAL_UNKNOWN_COMPETENCY.

error_type.description:
CF-chantier — famille pédagogique de l'erreur si le critère n'est pas matché:
- 'knowledge'      : connaissance factuelle manquante
- 'reasoning'      : raisonnement défaillant sur des données correctes
- 'behavior'       : comportement inapproprié (ton, gestion émotionnelle)
- 'regulatory'     : violation d'un cadre réglementaire (RGPD, éthique)
- 'communication'  : problème de formulation ou de canal
Orthogonal à severity : deux critères 'critical' peuvent avoir des error_type différents.

min_matches.description: How many keywords from the list must appear (default 1).

phaseEvent.description: Injected via runtime.injectPhaseEntryEvents. Idempotent per phaseId::eventId (see lib/phaseEventTracker).

toxic.description: Toxic clause: signing it as-is triggers a bad outcome in the debrief.

moderate.description: Moderate concern: warning in the debrief but not a hard fail.
